## 100. Al-Adiyat

**ٱلْعَادِيَات** · Al-Adiyat · Meka diim · 11 ayat

*By kargers boyo pant, striking sparks, raiding at dawn.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**100:1** By rasers panting.

وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا

**100:2** Igniting sparks.

فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا

**100:3** Raiding at dawn.

فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا

**100:4** Raising klouds of tolo.

فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا

**100:5** Storming into midst.

فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا

**100:6** Indeed, human being niyo ungrateful to imi Kamogim.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ

**100:7** Minte iyo bears witness to boyo.

وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ

**100:8** Minte iyo niyo fiers in imi lof of wealt.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

**100:9** Does iyo ba utam? When kontents of grafes are skattered around.

۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

**100:10** Minte kontents of aget are obtained.

وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

**100:11** Imi Kamogim, on boyo am, niyo fully informed of bilip.

إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ

---

## 101. Al-Qari'ah

**ٱلْقَارِعَة** · Al-Qari'ah · Meka diim · 11 ayat

*Striking kalamity: am unang tinum are lik skattered mots, amdu lik karded wool.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**101:1** Sokker.

ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:2** Intaben niyo sokker?

مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:3** Intaben will eksplain to kabo intaben sokker niyo?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:4** Am when unang tinum will be lik skattered mots.

يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ

**101:5** Minte amdu will be lik tufted wool.

وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ

**101:6** For iyo whos skales are heafy.

فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:7** Iyo will be in pleasant nan.

فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ

**101:8** Kuta for iyo whos skales are yogon.

وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:9** Imi hom niyo abyss.

فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ

**101:10** Do kabo utam intaben iyo niyo?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ

**101:11** Raging fir.

نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ

---

## 102. At-Takathur

**ٱلتَّكَاثُر** · At-Takathur · Meka diim · 8 ayat

*Rifalry in worldly inkreas distrakts kabo, until kabo fisit grafes.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**102:1** Abundans distrakts kabo.

أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

**102:2** Until kabo fisit grafeyards.

حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ

**102:3** Indeed, kabo will utam.

كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:4** Sertainly, kabo will utam.

ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:5** If kabo knew wit knowledg of sertainty.

كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:6** Kabo would atam inferno.

لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ

**102:7** Ten kabo will atam iyo wit tiin of sertainty.

ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:8** Ten, on boyo am, kabo will be kestioned about bliss.

ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

---

## 103. Al-Asr

**ٱلْعَصْر** · Al-Asr · Meka diim · 3 ayat

*By tim, tinum niyo in loss — ekssept boyo dok ilak dolin, do ipkuk, minte kounsel trut minte patiens.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**103:1** By tim.

وَٱلْعَصْرِ

**103:2** Human being niyo in loss.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

**103:3** Ekssept boyo dok ilak dolin, minte do tambal ogok, minte enkourag trut, minte rekommend patiens.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

---

## 104. Al-Humazah

**ٱلْهُمَزَة** · Al-Humazah · Meka diim · 9 ayat

*Woe to efery bakkbiter, slanderer, dok gaters wealt minte kounts iyo.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**104:1** Woe to efery slanderer bakkbiter.

وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ

**104:2** Dok gaters wealt minte kounts iyo ofer.

ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ

**104:3** Tinking boyo imi wealt has mad iyo immortal.

يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ

**104:4** By ba means. Iyo will be trown into kruser.

كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ

**104:5** Minte intaben will telela kabo realis intaben kruser niyo?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ

**104:6** God imi kindled fir.

نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

**104:7** Boyo laps to aget.

ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ

**104:8** Iyo kloses in on bilip.

إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ

**104:9** In ekstended kolumns.

فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ

---

## 105. Al-Fil

**ٱلْفِيل** · Al-Fil · Meka diim · 5 ayat

*Haf kabo ba seen how kapmi Kamogim dealt wit kompanions of elefant?*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**105:1** Haf kabo ba konsidered how kapmi Kamogim dealt wit unang tinum of elefant?

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

**105:2** Did iyo ba telela imi plan un wrong?

أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ

**105:3** Iyo sent against bilip swarms of nuuk.

وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

**105:4** Trowing at bilip rokks of baked klay.

تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ

**105:5** Leafing bilip lik kewed-up kalunganu.

فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ

---

## 106. Quraysh

**قُرَيْش** · Quraysh · Meka diim · 4 ayat

*For sekurity of Kurais — imi yourneys in winter minte summer.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**106:1** For sekurity of krais.

لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

**106:2** Imi sekurity during winter minte summer yourneys.

إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

**106:3** Let bilip aman duga Kamogim of koyo am.

فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

**106:4** Dok has fed bilip against hunger, minte has sekured bilip against finan.

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

---

## 107. Al-Ma'un

**ٱلْمَاعُون** · Al-Ma'un · Meka diim · 7 ayat

*Haf kabo seen maak dok denies yudgement? Iyo niyo iyo dok puses away orfan.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**107:1** Haf kabo konsidered iyo dok denies religion?

أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

**107:2** Iyo niyo iyo dok mistreats orfan.

فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

**107:3** Minte does ba enkourag feeding of poor.

وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**107:4** So woe to boyo dok aman duga.

فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

**107:5** Boyo dok are heedless of imi prayers.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

**107:6** Boyo dok put on appearans.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

**107:7** Minte withold assistans.

وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ

---

## 108. Al-Kawthar

**ٱلْكَوْثَر** · Al-Kawthar · Meka diim · 3 ayat

*Nuyo haf gifen kabo abundans — so aman duga to kapmi Kamogim minte sakrifis.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**108:1** Nuyo haf gifen kabo plenty.

إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

**108:2** So aman duga to kapmi Kamogim minte sakrifis.

فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ

**108:3** Iyo dok hates kabo niyo loser.

إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

---

## 109. Al-Kafirun

**ٱلْكَافِرُون** · Al-Kafirun · Meka diim · 6 ayat

*Bogo: o disbeliefers, niyo do ba aman duga intaben kabo aman duga.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**109:1** Bogo, “o disbeliefers.

قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

**109:2** Niyo do ba aman duga intaben kabo aman duga.

لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**109:3** Nor do kabo aman duga intaben niyo aman duga.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:4** Nor do niyo serf intaben kabo serf.

وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

**109:5** Nor do kabo serf intaben niyo serf.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:6** Kabo haf kapmi way, minte niyo haf nimi way.”

لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

---

## 110. An-Nasr

**ٱلنَّصْر** · An-Nasr · Madina diim · 3 ayat

*When help of God tal, minte fiktory, minte kabo atam unang tinum enter religion in krowds.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**110:1** When ter tal God imi fiktory, minte konkest.

إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

**110:2** Minte kabo atam unang tinum entering God imi religion in multitudes.

وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا

**110:3** Ten selebrat prais of kapmi Kamogim, minte seek imi forgifeness. Iyo niyo aksepter of repentans.

فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

---

## 111. Al-Masad

**ٱلْمَسَد** · Al-Masad · Meka diim · 5 ayat

*Peris sagaal of aalap of flam — tinum of wealt, kalel dok karries firewood.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**111:1** Kondemned are sagaal of abe lahab, minte iyo niyo kondemned.

تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ

**111:2** Imi wealt did ba afail iyo, nor did intaben iyo akkired.

مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

**111:3** Iyo will burn in flaming fir.

سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ

**111:4** Minte imi kalel — firewood karrier.

وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ

**111:5** Around iyo fuk niyo rop of torns.

فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ

---

## 112. Al-Ikhlas

**ٱلْإِخْلَاص** · Al-Ikhlas · Meka diim · 4 ayat

*Bogo: iyo niyo God, maak. God, absolut. Iyo begets ba, nor niyo iyo begotten.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**112:1** Bogo, “iyo niyo God, maak.

قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

**112:2** God, absolut.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

**112:3** Iyo begets ba, nor was iyo begotten.

لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

**112:4** Minte ter niyo ba komparabl to iyo.”

وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ

---

## 113. Al-Falaq

**ٱلْفَلَق** · Al-Falaq · Meka diim · 5 ayat

*Bogo: niyo seek refug in Kamogim of daybreak, from efil of intaben iyo telela.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**113:1** Bogo, “niyo kulu refug wit Kamogim of daybreak.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

**113:2** From efil of intaben iyo telela.

مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

**113:3** Minte from efil of darkness iyo gaters.

وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

**113:4** Minte from efil of boyo dok praktis sorsery.

وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ

**113:5** Minte from efil of enfious when iyo enfies.”

وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

---

## 114. An-Nas

**ٱلنَّاس** · An-Nas · Meka diim · 6 ayat

*Bogo: niyo seek refug in Kamogim of mankind, king of mankind, God of mankind.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*God imi win diim, Kupka, Filin*

**114:1** Bogo, “niyo seek refug in Kamogim of mankind.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:2** King of mankind.

مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:3** God of mankind.

إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:4** From efil of sneaky whisperer.

مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ

**114:5** Dok whispers into aget of unang tinum.

ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:6** From among yinn minte among unang tinum.”

مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

---
